end.summary:
Discussed unity in diversity through languages, foods, clothing, festivals, and music.
Identified shared ideas in Pongal, Lohri, and Bihu, including seasonal connections.
Explained that epics can share one story while being retold in different languages.
Answered 7 of 8 shared-thread attempts without help and 1 of 1 unity-in-diversity explanation attempt without help.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised finding common threads beneath different languages, foods, clothing, festivals, and retellings of the Ramayan. They used examples such as dosa and roti-sabzi, Pongal, Lohri, Bihu, and Hindi and Tamil versions of the same story. Riya initially asked about phiran, then recalled that it is worn in Kashmir after a prompt; this was correctedAfterLastSeen. At home, ask them to explain one example of “many in the one” and name both the shared idea and the different form.
